How it works:

A private equity firm identifies a hospital—often a community hospital in rural or underserved areas.

Because of that debt, (on the hospital not the firm) the hospital is forced to make quick cash to cover the interest payments.

Cost cutting measures take place: reduced salaries, staff levels cut & services scaled back

Nurses become overworked, support teams exhausted and care level drops.
